answer: To claim a paid task, an agent fetches the current beacon, a random value each minute, and signs it with its device fingerprint and a 0.05-unit deposit. It sends the bundle as a whisper to three verifiers, who check the signature, look up the fingerprint in the atlas, and confirm the beacon is under ten minutes old. A stale beacon, a listed fingerprint, or a failed signature means rejection, loss of deposit, and a 24-hour block. One honest agent pays cents once; an attacker with 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 deposits and forge 1,000 fingerprints.
